latestVersion.changelog:
ai-rtk-compressor 1.0.0

- Initial release of AI RTK Compressor for fast, cloud-based video compression.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV (up to 2GB) for 1080p MP4 export using RTK encoding.
- Automated session and token setup, with transparent status updates and credit handling.
- Keyword-driven workflow: upload, compress, export, check credits, and show timeline status.
- Designed for content creators and videographers to reduce video file sizes quickly, no manual codec settings needed.
